title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - DataAccountExport
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/DataAccountExport. List of methods to export data from your account out of the service.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DataAccountExport'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

requestType.description: Property. The mean to request data retrieval.

formatType.description: Property. Type of Media Types (formerly known as MIME types) as defined by IANA.
